text:
pm-ryan: postmortem follow-up: we need a short-lived "streaming bridge" to own reconnects, partial chunk handling, and timeout mitigation. goal: no regressions for 14 days. owners + concrete tasks below.

Sanjay: I will own client reconnect lib and ensure KV resume is safe. will implement exp backoff + jitter and max_retries=3 by default. sample: `backoff_ms=[250,600,1400], jitter=0.2`.

Maria: I'll add `partial_chunk_detected` metric and a Prom alert. Suggest page if >5/min for 3m in prod. I'll add a region heatmap to the dashboard.

Ken: I'll write a concise runbook (detection -> quick retry -> fallback -> escalation) and own the canary rollout for the reconnect lib.

pm-ryan: action items:
- RED-8201 SANJAY: reconnect lib + unit tests + CI harness (ETA Wed)
- RED-8202 MARIA: partial_chunk metric + alert + dashboard (ETA Thu)
- RED-8203 KEN: runbook + canary steps (ETA Mon)
- RED-8204 SANJAY: CI test that simulates dropped-last-chunk and ensures no token double-count (ETA Thu)

Sanjay: note: client logs should include `request_id`, `session_id`, `last_chunk_index`, `kv_resume_token`. will add a small shim.

Maria: prefer alerts to auto-create a prefilled ticket with request/session IDs. speeds triage.

Ken: agreed, will add ticket template to runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging reconnect-lib v0.9.3 by Sanjay, 2026-03-28T04:00:00Z.

ops-bot: recurring event created: "Streaming Bridge (two-week)" Mon/Wed 30m starting 2026-03-30. Invites sent. :white_check_mark:

pm-ryan: owners update RED tickets with acceptance criteria and test plan today. reconvene next Tue for rollup. escalate to P0 if partial_chunk spikes.

Sanjay: ack, will post PR link here.

Maria: ack, ping me for dashboard pairing.

Ken: ack, will publish runbook to docs/incident-runbooks and link here.

pm-ryan: thanks all, this thread is canonical for the bridge owners until we hit 14 clean days.
